The '''''Cardan V''-class space station''' was the fifth model of [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space station]] built for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the ultimate in the ''Cardan'' designs and served as both a defensive emplacement and shipyard. It was, with the right resources, capable of building and repairing an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].

==History==
These stations supplemented the earlier ''Cardan''-class models. Three ''Cardan V''-class space stations were present during the [[Battle for the Eclipse|Battle for the ''Eclipse'']] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], where a combined [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] fleet destroyed them all.
